description: This file defines deployment configuration classes, promotion strategies, and functions to determine deployment environments based on branch names and timing logic for a software deployment pipeline.

classes.name: DeploymentSteps
classes.description: Represents a sequence of environment steps and a promotion strategy for deployment.

classes.name: DeploymentConfiguration
classes.description: Extends DeploymentSteps to include a deployment name, representing a specific deployment setup.

methods.name: getDeploymentConfiguration
methods.description: Returns a DeploymentConfiguration object for a given deployment name.

methods.name: calculateDeploymentName
methods.description: Determines the deployment environment name based on branch ref and shard type.
